async def act(page):
    # Click the first 'Edit' link to go to the address edit page (likely shipping address)
    # Use filter to select the first 'Edit' link under the main section
    await page.get_by_role("main").get_by_role("link", name="Edit").first.click()
    # Wait for navigation to the address edit page
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Fill in the new address details
    # Use get_by_role with appropriate names based on typical form labels
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Street Address").fill("321 Birch Boulevard, Suite 200")
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="City").fill("Dallas")
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="State/Province").fill("TX")
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Zip/Postal Code").fill("75201")
    # Click the save button to submit the form
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save Address").click()
    # Wait for the page to update after saving
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
